verdicts.reason: Both banners cram every element from the original into the 320×50 strip. Each one ends up with illegible micro-sized body copy, a tiny pill CTA squeezed into the top row next to a chip, and a bunched-up right-hand cluster beside a large serif headline. In A, the FREE DELIVERY badge is oversized and runs off the right edge, so it competes with the CTA as a focal point. In B, the badge is smaller and stays inside the canvas, so B is a little cleaner, but its CTA and chips are still unreadably small.
